title_primary: 《农业经济学杂志》在农业经济学中的定位：基于文本的分析
title_secondary:
The
                    JAE
                    's Positioning Within Agricultural Economics: A Text‐Based Analysis
authors: Leonardo Cei, Gianluca Stefani, Edi Defrancesco
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: On the occasion of the centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society, this study investigates the positioning of the Journal of Agricultural Economics (JAE) within the broader landscape of the main agricultural economics journals. We employ a quantitative text analysis approach, estimating a Structural Topic Model (STM) on a unique corpus of 13,140 abstracts from the JAE and six leading peer journals covering the period 1970–2024. Our results suggest that the JAE shares common trends with its peers, such as an increasing segmentation and specialisation of the topics addressed, and a commensurate growth in the use of specialised techniques, such as causal identification and experimental economics. At the same time, features differentiating the JAE from the other journals emerge as well. These include a strong focus on production issues and agricultural policy, as well as on the environmental and natural resource implications of production decisions. This contrasts with the relatively lower attention devoted to food and nutrition aspects, despite greater focus on consumption dynamics, in line with a general trend in the discipline. Overall, this analysis highlights that the JAE maintains a strong connection with core aspects of the discipline, while differentiating itself in specific areas of investigation.

title: Monetary policy’s ‘last-mile problem’ and what can be done about it
title_zh: 货币政策的“最后一英里问题”及其应对之策
title_primary: 货币政策的“最后一英里问题”及其应对之策

authors: Shane Byrne, Kenneth Devine, Michael King, Yvonne McCarthy, Christopher Palmer
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Central banks can move policy rates, but transmission depends on households acting on them. This column shows that central banks can mitigate monetary policy’s ‘last-mile problem’ with direct communication. In Ireland, a mortgage refinancing reminder increased refinancing with borrowers' existing lender by up to 76% relative to the control group, from 8.9% to 15.7% of borrowers. The results suggest that inattention is a key friction and that central bank communication holds promise.
abstract_zh: 中央银行能够调整政策利率，但其传导效果取决于家庭对此作出的反应。本文指出，中央银行可通过直接沟通来缓解货币政策的“最后一公里难题”。在爱尔兰，一项抵押贷款再融资提醒措施使得借款人在现有贷款机构进行再融资的比例相较于对照组提升了高达76%，即从8.9%上升至15.7%。研究结果表明，注意力不足是关键的摩擦因素，而中央银行的沟通策略展现出积极前景。

title: Can term limits accelerate women's access to top political positions? Quasi-experimental evidence from Italy
title_zh: 任期限制能否加速女性进入高层政治职位？来自意大利的准实验证据
title_primary: 任期限制能否加速女性进入高层政治职位？来自意大利的准实验证据
title_secondary: Can term limits accelerate women's access to top political positions? Quasi-experimental evidence from Italy
authors: Carolina Kansikas, Manuel Bagues
official: 官方在线 2024-07-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate whether term limits can help historically underrepresented groups, such as women, gain faster access to positions of political power. We exploit evidence from Italian local elections where, in a context of rapidly increasing women's presence in politics, mayoral term limits were extended from two to three five-year terms in municipalities with less than 3,000 inhabitants in 2014 and in those with a population between 3,000 and 5,000 in 2022. Using as control group slightly larger municipalities, we find that longer term limits delay younger cohorts' access to mayoral roles, significantly slowing the increase in female representation. The magnitude of the effect is substantial; the share of female mayors would be 4-10 percentage points higher if term limits had not been extended. The impact is stronger in municipalities with a larger presence of women at lower political levels and where gender quotas are in place, suggesting a complementarity between these policies. Our findings suggest that term limits help bridge the representational gap between entry and top-level political positions, especially in times of rapid societal change.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨任期限制是否有助于历史上处于弱势地位的群体（如女性）更快地获得政治权力职位。我们利用意大利地方选举的证据，在女性政治参与迅速增加的背景下，市长任期限制从两届延长至三届，每届五年，适用于2014年人口少于3000人的市镇及2022年人口在3000至5000人之间的市镇。以稍大的市镇作为对照组，我们发现更长的任期限制延迟了较年轻群体担任市长职务的机会，显著减缓了女性代表性的增长。这一效应规模显著；若未延长任期限制，女性市长的比例将高出4至10个百分点。在较低政治层级女性参与度较高及实施性别配额制的市镇中，这一影响更为强烈，表明这些政策之间存在互补性。我们的研究结果表明，任期限制有助于缩小进入政治体系与高层政治职位之间的代表性差距，尤其是在社会快速变革时期。

title: The Engineering of Consumer Experiences Under Affect Assimilation and Quality Contrast
title_zh: 情感同化与质量对比下的消费者体验工程
title_primary: 情感同化与质量对比下的消费者体验工程
title_secondary: The Engineering of Consumer Experiences Under Affect Assimilation and Quality Contrast
authors: Abhishek Deshmane, Victor Martínez-de-Albéniz, Guillaume Roels
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Consumer experiences are inherently dynamic. When engaging in a sequence of activities, consumers are influenced by past experiences in two ways: negatively by their objective quality, through quality contrast; and positively by their subjective appreciation of them, through affect assimilation. How should experience curators sequence activities to maximize consumer satisfaction in the presence of such intertemporal effects? We formulate an experience curator’s problem as a dynamic optimization program. We show that, because of affect assimilation, the best activity may be scheduled at the beginning or in the middle of an experience, in contrast to the common peak-end rule—this provides a rationale for the saying that “first impressions matter.” Under uncertainty, it may be valuable to save the best activity as a “wild card” to recover from bad outcomes. We calibrate our model to four distinct experiential contexts (namely, watching movies, reading books, visiting touristic attractions, and eating out) and consistently find the presence of both quality contrast and affect assimilation. Through a counterfactual study in the context of touristic tours, we show that experience curators may significantly benefit from offering different fixed sequences to different types of consumers, but they tend to gain little from dynamically adjusting them. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Agencia Estatal de Investigación [Grant PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150 .
abstract_zh: 消费者体验本质上是动态的。在参与一系列活动时，消费者会以两种方式受到过往经历的影响：一方面，通过质量对比，客观质量产生负面影响；另一方面，通过情感同化，主观欣赏产生正面影响。在此类跨期效应存在的情况下，体验策划者应如何安排活动顺序以最大化消费者满意度？我们将体验策划者的问题构建为动态优化模型。研究表明，由于情感同化的作用，最佳活动可能被安排在体验的开始或中间阶段，这与常见的“峰终定律”相悖——这为“第一印象至关重要”的说法提供了理论依据。在不确定性条件下，保留最佳活动作为“王牌”以应对不良结果可能具有价值。我们将模型校准至四种不同的体验情境（即观影、阅读书籍、游览旅游景点及外出就餐），并一致发现质量对比与情感同化同时存在。通过旅游观光情境下的反事实研究，我们表明体验策划者通过向不同类型的消费者提供不同的固定序列可显著获益，但动态调整序列所带来的收益往往甚微。本文由David Simchi-Levi（运营管理领域）接受。资助：本研究受西班牙国家研究机构[基金号PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150获取。

title: Why Has Economic Growth Slowed When Innovation Appears To Be Accelerating?
title_zh: 为何创新看似加速而经济增长却放缓？
title_primary: 为何创新看似加速而经济增长却放缓？
title_secondary: Why Has Economic Growth Slowed When Innovation Appears To Be Accelerating?
authors: Robert J. Gordon
official: 官方在线 2018-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: U. S. economic growth slowed by more than half from 3.2 percent per year during 1970-2006 to only 1.4 percent during 2006-16, and this decline was divided equally between slower growth in hours of work and slower growth in output per hour. In explaining slower growth in hours, particular emphasis is placed on the slower secular rise of life expectancy in the U.S. compared to other developed countries. Further contributions to slowing growth are made by a decline in the population share of both legal and illegal immigration and a turnaround from rising to declining labor force participation. Causes of declining productivity growth begin with the slowdown in the rate of increase of educational attainment. Why did productivity growth decline after 2006 despite an increase in the rate at which new U.S. patents were issued in 2006-16 compared to earlier decades? Part of the slowdown is attributed to the maturity of the IT revolution, which also helps to explain the trajectory of the college wage premium. Aspects of the productivity growth slowdown include the declining productivity of research workers, diminishing returns to drug innovation, and the evolutionary rather than revolutionary impact of robots and artificial intelligence.
abstract_zh: 美国经济增长速度从1970年至2006年间年均3.2%放缓至2006年至2016年间仅1.4%，降幅超过一半，且这一下降在工时增长放缓与每小时产出增长放缓之间平分。在解释工时增长放缓时，特别强调了美国与其他发达国家相比，人均预期寿命的长期增长较为缓慢。此外，合法与非法移民人口占比的下降，以及劳动力参与率从上升转为下降的趋势，也对增长放缓有所贡献。生产力增长放缓的原因始于教育程度提升速度的减缓。为何在2006年至2016年间，尽管美国新专利发放速度较前几十年有所加快，生产力增长却出现下滑？部分放缓归因于信息技术革命的成熟，这也助于解释大学教育工资溢价的走势。生产力增长放缓的多个方面包括研究人员生产力的下降、药物创新回报的递减，以及机器人及人工智能带来的影响更偏向于渐进式而非革命性。

title: Fiscal Progressivity and the Time Consistency of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 财政累进性与货币政策的时间一致性
title_primary: 财政累进性与货币政策的时间一致性
title_secondary: Fiscal Progressivity and the Time Consistency of Monetary Policy
authors: ANTOINE CAMOUS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies how progressive fiscal policy shapes monetary policy in a heterogeneous‐agent economy. Progressive labor taxation, though distortionary, can mitigate the inflation bias of monetary policy by redistributing income. I examine this commitment channel through the lens of political conflict. When agents vote on monetary and fiscal instruments, progressivity curbs inflation bias by creating distributional tensions: lower productivity agents support higher labor taxes to protect the value of money holdings and shift tax distortions toward higher productivity agents. Anticipating lower inflation, all agents ultimately prefer adopting a progressive fiscal system.
abstract_zh: 本文研究累进性财政政策如何在异质性主体经济中塑造货币政策。尽管累进劳动税具有扭曲效应，但可通过收入再分配缓解货币政策的通胀偏差。本文通过政治冲突视角考察这一承诺渠道。当经济主体对货币与财政工具进行投票时，累进税制通过制造分配性张力抑制通胀偏差：低生产率主体支持提高劳动税以保护货币持有价值，并将税收扭曲转嫁给高生产率主体。由于预期通胀水平降低，所有经济主体最终都倾向于采用累进性财政体系。

title: Debt service and fiscal sustainability
title_zh: 债务服务与财政可持续性
title_primary: 债务服务与财政可持续性
title_secondary: Debt service and fiscal sustainability
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Maxime Menuet, Gregory Donnat
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Debt sustainability analysis typically focuses on debt stocks and the interest rate-growth rate differential, but these are not perfect predictors of fiscal stress. This column argues that debt-service costs are key to understanding when fiscal adjustments become necessary. Using long-run historical evidence, it shows that primary surpluses are more closely associated with debt-service costs than with debt ratios, and that fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate. Overall, debt-service costs represent the immediate claim of public debt on government resources and therefore provide a more direct measure of fiscal pressure than debt ratios alone.
abstract_zh: 债务可持续性分析通常关注债务存量及利率与增长率之差，但这些指标并非财政压力的完美预测因子。本文认为，偿债成本是理解何时需要进行财政调整的关键。基于长期历史证据表明，基本盈余与偿债成本的关联性高于与债务比率的关联性，且当融资条件恶化时，财政应对措施会显著加强。总体而言，偿债成本代表了公共债务对政府资源的即时索取权，因此相较于单纯的债务比率，它能更直接地衡量财政压力。

title: DP743 Privatization, Risk-Taking, and the Communist Firm
title_zh: 私有化、风险承担与共产主义企业
title_primary: 私有化、风险承担与共产主义企业
title_secondary: DP743 Privatization, Risk-Taking, and the Communist Firm
authors: Hans-Wener Sinn, Dominique Demougin, Markus Behn, Stijn Claessens, Leonardo Gambacorta 等
official: 官方在线 1993-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies alternative methods of privatizing a formerly communist firm in the presence of imperfect risk markets. The methods include cash sales, a give-away scheme, and a participation contract where the government retains a sleeping fractional ownership in the firm. It is shown that with competitive bidding, the participation contract dominates cash sales because it generates both more private restructuring investment and a higher expected present value of revenue for the government. Under weak conditions the participation contract will induce more investment than the giveaway scheme, and it may even share the cash sales' virtue of incentive compatibility.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在不完全风险市场条件下，对前共产主义企业进行私有化的替代方案。这些方案包括现金出售、无偿分配计划，以及政府保留企业部分被动股权的参与合同。研究表明，在竞标机制下，参与合同优于现金出售，因为它既能促进更多私人重组投资，又能为政府带来更高的预期收入现值。在较弱条件下，参与合同比无偿分配计划更能激励投资，甚至可能兼具现金出售在激励相容性方面的优势。

title: The Great Depression as a Watershed: International Capital Mobility over the Long Run
title_zh: 大萧条作为分水岭：长期国际资本流动
title_primary: 大萧条作为分水岭：长期国际资本流动
title_secondary: The Great Depression as a Watershed: International Capital Mobility over the Long Run
authors: Maurice Obstfeld, Alan M. Taylor
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2007-10-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper surveys the evolution of international capital mobility since the late-nineteenth century. It begins with an overview of empirical evidence on the fall and rise of integration in the global capital market. A discussion of institutional developments focuses on the use of capital controls and the pursuit of domestic macroeconomic policy objectives in the context of changing monetary regimes. A fundamental macroeconomic policy trilemma has forced policy-makers to trade off conflicting goals. The natural implication of the trilemma is that capital mobility has prevailed and expanded under circumstances of widespread political support either for an exchange rate subordinated monetary policy regime (e.g. the gold standard), or for a monetary regime geared mainly towards domestic objectives at the expense of exchange rate stability (e.g. the recent float). Through its effect on popular attitudes towards both the gold standard and the legitimate scope for government macroeconomic intervention, the Great Depression emerges as the key turning point in the recent history of international capital markets.
abstract_zh: 本文梳理了自19世纪末以来国际资本流动性的演变历程。首先概述了全球资本市场一体化兴衰的实证证据。在制度发展讨论中，重点分析了资本管制手段的运用，以及不同货币制度背景下各国追求国内宏观经济政策目标的行为。一个根本性的宏观经济政策三难困境迫使决策者在相互冲突的目标间进行权衡。该三难困境的自然推论是：当汇率从属于货币政策（如金本位制）或货币政策主要服务于国内目标而牺牲汇率稳定（如近期浮动汇率制）获得广泛政治支持时，资本流动性便得以盛行并扩张。通过影响民众对金本位制及政府宏观经济干预合理范围的认知，大萧条成为国际资本市场近代史中的关键转折点。

title: The uncertainty premium of climate tipping points
title_zh: 气候临界点的不确定性溢价
title_primary: 气候临界点的不确定性溢价
title_secondary: The uncertainty premium of climate tipping points
authors: Andrea Titton
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: There are tipping points in the climate system that could lock the world into a higher-temperature regime. Many tipping points are characterised by Knightian uncertainty, that is, it is difficult to assign prior probabilities to their occurrence. This paper quantifies the economic cost of this uncertainty using a min-max regret robust policy in an integrated assessment model with temperature feedback effects. By not imposing prior probabilities over critical thresholds, the framework provides policy guidance when threshold forecasting and learning are limited. I compute the implied social cost of carbon under the robust policy and compare it to the complete information benchmark. The uncertainty premium is modest at the start of the transition, between 1% and 2.2% in 2020, but rises to approximately 20% by the end of the century as robust and complete information policy paths diverge. These results imply that tipping-point ambiguity is not a first-order driver of carbon pricing in the short run, but becomes significant over policy-relevant horizons, strengthening the case for precautionary abatement.
abstract_zh: 气候系统中存在临界点，一旦越过，可能将世界锁定在更高温度的状态。许多临界点具有奈特不确定性特征，即难以为其发生赋予先验概率。本文通过一个包含温度反馈效应的综合评估模型，采用最小最大遗憾稳健政策来量化这种不确定性的经济成本。通过不对临界阈值施加先验概率，该框架在阈值预测和学习受限时提供了政策指导。我计算了稳健政策下隐含的碳社会成本，并将其与完全信息基准进行比较。不确定性溢价在转型初期较为温和，2020年为1%至2.2%，但到本世纪末，随着稳健政策路径与完全信息政策路径的分化，该溢价上升至约20%。这些结果表明，临界点模糊性在短期内并非碳定价的一阶驱动因素，但在政策相关的时间范围内变得显著，从而强化了预防性减排的理由。

title: Productivity-carbon trade-offs in Ghana: Quantifying the roles of irrigation and organic farming in land-use optimisation
title_zh: 加纳生产力-碳权衡：量化灌溉与有机农业在土地利用优化中的作用
title_primary: 加纳生产力-碳权衡：量化灌溉与有机农业在土地利用优化中的作用
title_secondary: Productivity-carbon trade-offs in Ghana: Quantifying the roles of irrigation and organic farming in land-use optimisation
authors: Kwaku Asuako Tabiri
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural expansion in Ghana continues to drive deforestation, posing a major challenge to balancing food production with forest carbon conservation. While Sustainable Agricultural Intensification (SAI) is widely promoted, its ecological and land use planning implications remain underexplored in policy contexts. This study investigates the trade-offs between agricultural intensification and forest carbon conservation, aiming to identify land use configurations that optimise both productivity and environmental sustainability within Ghana’s national planning framework. Using a 31-year FAOSTAT dataset, a socio-ecological systems approach integrating Random Forest and polynomial regression models was applied to capture non-linear dynamics. A multi-objective optimisation framework was used to derive Pareto-optimal land use allocations under empirical constraints, reflecting real-world policy and adoption limitations. Findings reveal that land use composition – particularly the cropland-pasture balance – has a stronger influence on forest carbon stocks than intensification alone. Low adoption rates of irrigation and organic farming limit their national impact. The optimal land use mix (58.85% cropland, 41.15% pasture, 1% organic, 3.01% irrigated) achieves 92% of a composite objective prioritising productivity (70%) and carbon conservation (30%). These results underscore the need for spatially differentiated land use policies that incorporate zoning, targeted incentives, and coordinated landscape governance. The study shows that the ecological impacts of intensification depend on its scale, type, and socio-ecological context. For policymakers, this highlights the need to move beyond uniform SAI approaches toward spatially targeted strategies that integrate land-use zoning, practice-specific incentives, and coordinated landscape management to balance agricultural productivity with forest conservation.
abstract_zh: 加纳农业扩张持续加剧森林砍伐，对平衡粮食生产与森林碳汇保护构成重大挑战。尽管可持续农业集约化（SAI）被广泛推广，但其生态影响及土地利用规划意义在政策语境中仍未得到充分探讨。本研究探究农业集约化与森林碳汇保护之间的权衡关系，旨在识别在国家规划框架内同时优化生产力与环境可持续性的土地利用配置方案。基于31年FAOSTAT数据集，采用整合随机森林与多项式回归模型的社会-生态系统方法捕捉非线性动态，并运用多目标优化框架在经验约束条件下推导帕累托最优土地利用分配方案，以反映现实政策与采纳限制。研究发现：土地利用构成（尤其是农田-牧场比例）对森林碳储量的影响强于集约化本身；灌溉与有机农业的低采纳率限制了其国家层面影响；最优土地利用组合（58.85%农田、41.15%牧场、1%有机农业、3.01%灌溉面积）可实现优先考虑生产力（70%）与碳汇保护（30%）的复合目标值的92%。这些结果凸显了制定空间差异化土地利用政策的必要性，需整合分区规划、定向激励与协调性景观治理。研究表明，集约化的生态影响取决于其规模、类型及社会-生态背景。对政策制定者而言，这要求超越统一的SAI方法，转向整合土地利用分区、实践导向激励与协调性景观管理的空间靶向策略，以平衡农业生产与森林保护。

title: Partisan Differences Among Independents: Evidence from Household Economic Expectations
title_zh: 独立选民中的党派差异：来自家庭经济预期的证据
title_primary: 独立选民中的党派差异：来自家庭经济预期的证据
title_secondary: Partisan Differences Among Independents: Evidence from Household Economic Expectations
authors: Pedro Simon
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I document that self-declared politically Independent households with partisan leanings change economic expectations in ways that resemble weak partisans. Republican leaners align more with weak Republicans, while Democratic leaners are similar to weak Democrats in their macroeconomic beliefs. This insight has important implications for survey design and for how researchers categorize political affiliation in economic analyses. Classifying leaners as neutral Independents can distort estimates of partisan differences.
abstract_zh: 我记录到，自称政治独立但带有党派倾向的家庭，其经济预期的变化方式类似于弱党派支持者。共和党倾向者与弱共和党人的宏观经济信念更为一致，而民主党倾向者则与弱民主党人相似。这一发现对调查设计以及研究人员在经济分析中如何划分政治归属具有重要意义。将倾向者归类为中立的独立派可能会扭曲对党派差异的估计。

title: Investment Dynamics and Monetary Policy Shocks: Evidence from EMU Family Firms
title_zh: 投资动态与货币政策冲击：来自欧洲货币联盟家族企业的证据
title_primary: 投资动态与货币政策冲击：来自欧洲货币联盟家族企业的证据
title_secondary: Investment Dynamics and Monetary Policy Shocks: Evidence from EMU Family Firms
authors: Paolo Canofari, Alessandro Piergallini, Matteo Renghini
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines family firms’ response to monetary policy tightening. By using a panel of about 130,000 non-listed EMU firms over the period 2011–2021, we show that family firms are more resilient to monetary policy shocks. Compared to non-family firms, they react to interest rate hikes by reducing tangible investments to a lesser extent. Fully family-controlled firms suffer a lower reduction in revenue and reallocate their debt from short to long term liabilities. Our results provide evidence of the existence of a corporate-ownership transmission channel. The presence of family firms appears to be an additional source of heterogeneity in response to monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了家族企业对货币政策紧缩的响应。利用2011至2021年间约13万家欧元区非上市企业的面板数据，我们发现家族企业对货币政策冲击更具韧性。与非家族企业相比，家族企业对利率上调的反应表现为有形投资减少幅度较小。完全由家族控制的企业收入下降幅度较低，并将债务从短期负债重新配置至长期负债。我们的研究结果为存在企业所有权传导渠道提供了证据。家族企业的存在似乎是货币政策响应异质性的又一来源。

title: Spatial and socio-geographical determinants of urban nature-based solutions (NBS) for climate resilience, biodiversity, and green space management
title_zh: 城市基于自然的解决方案（NBS）在气候韧性、生物多样性与绿地管理中的空间与社会地理决定因素
title_primary: 城市基于自然的解决方案（NBS）在气候韧性、生物多样性与绿地管理中的空间与社会地理决定因素
title_secondary: Spatial and socio-geographical determinants of urban nature-based solutions (NBS) for climate resilience, biodiversity, and green space management
authors: Mücahit Kaya, Barbara Sowińska-Świerkosz
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Although urban nature-based solutions (NBS) generally produce positive results compared to non-NBS interventions, translating these evidence-based approaches into site-specific and measurable applications within urban contexts remains challenging. Key questions remain regarding the optimal number, location, and spatial extent of NBS required to maximize their effectiveness. NBS must possess sufficient size and spatial distribution to support ecological stability and enhance ecosystem services. However, most cities face constraints due to limited available open space. This study investigates how the spatial characteristics of NBS influence their effectiveness in mitigating three selected UCs and examines the relationship between these characteristics and the socio-geographical context. Case studies from Poland (Lublin) and Türkiye (Istanbul) were analyzed across 17 NBS types and 26 indicators. The results indicate that, irrespective of socio-geographical context, urban waters and forests exert the greatest influence on climate resilience. In terms of green space management, the Polish case demonstrated higher overall effectiveness. Nevertheless, the findings did not conclusively demonstrate a direct relationship between NBS spatial structure and biodiversity enhancement. Beyond spatial factors, proximity to UCs, multifunctionality, and protected status emerged as critical determinants of NBS contributions to urban challenges. The evidence generated in this study can inform urban policy and planning by integrating spatial and socio-geographical considerations, thereby optimizing the potential of NBS to effectively mitigate urban challenges.
abstract_zh: 尽管城市基于自然的解决方案（NBS）相较于非NBS干预措施通常能产生积极成效，但将这些基于证据的方法转化为城市环境中针对具体地点且可量化的应用仍具挑战性。关于最大化其有效性所需的NBS最佳数量、位置及空间范围，关键问题依然存在。NBS必须具备足够的规模和空间分布，以支持生态稳定性并增强生态系统服务。然而，大多数城市面临可用开放空间有限的制约。本研究探讨了NBS的空间特征如何影响其在缓解三种选定城市挑战（UCs）方面的有效性，并考察了这些特征与社会地理背景之间的关系。研究分析了来自波兰（卢布林）和土耳其（伊斯坦布尔）的案例，涵盖17种NBS类型和26项指标。结果表明，无论社会地理背景如何，城市水域和森林对气候韧性的影响最大。在绿地管理方面，波兰案例显示出更高的整体有效性。然而，研究结果并未确凿证明NBS空间结构与生物多样性增强之间存在直接关系。除空间因素外，与UCs的邻近性、多功能性及保护状态成为决定NBS对城市挑战贡献的关键因素。本研究产生的证据可通过整合空间与社会地理考量，为城市政策与规划提供信息，从而优化NBS在有效缓解城市挑战方面的潜力。

title: Do common shocks drive changes in aggregate emissions intensity?
title_zh: 共同冲击是否驱动了总排放强度的变化？
title_primary: 共同冲击是否驱动了总排放强度的变化？
title_secondary: Do common shocks drive changes in aggregate emissions intensity?
authors: Xiyu Ren, Fulvia Marotta, François Lafond
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the UK, aggregate emissions intensity has declined by about a factor of two over the last three decades. Prior research attributes most of this decline to reductions within industries rather than shifts in the composition of economic activity. This paper investigates whether such within-industry progress primarily reflects industry-specific factors or common forces operating across industries. Using a newly constructed panel of UK industry-level GHG emissions and gross value added for 1990–2022, we estimate a block-level dynamic factor model that decomposes changes in emissions intensity into global, block-level, and idiosyncratic components. We find that industry-specific factors account for the majority of variation in emissions intensity changes, though common shocks, either global or at the level of groups of industries, play a smaller but non-negligible role. We further show how patterns of co-movement partly reflect the way that emissions are recorded at the activity level and allocated to industries, a feature with implications for interpreting industry-level decarbonization dynamics.
abstract_zh: 在英国，过去三十年间，总体排放强度大约下降了一半。先前的研究将这一下降主要归因于行业内部的减排，而非经济活动构成的转变。本文旨在探究这种行业内部的进步究竟主要反映了行业特有的因素，还是跨行业运作的共同力量。利用我们新构建的1990年至2022年英国行业级温室气体排放及总增加值面板数据，我们估计了一个区块级动态因子模型，将排放强度的变化分解为全球性、区块级及特质性成分。研究发现，行业特有因素解释了排放强度变化中的大部分变异，尽管全球性或行业群体层面的共同冲击作用较小，但也不容忽视。我们进一步展示了共同变动模式如何部分反映排放按活动层面记录并分配到行业的方式，这一特征对解读行业级脱碳动态具有重要意义。

title: The Role of Information in Pharmaceutical Advertising: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 信息在药品广告中的作用：理论与证据
title_primary: 信息在药品广告中的作用：理论与证据
title_secondary: The Role of Information in Pharmaceutical Advertising: Theory and Evidence
authors: Kelli Marquardt, Conor Ryan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper theoretically and empirically examines the role of information in pharmaceutical detailing (promotional interactions between drug representatives and physicians). We start with a theoretical framework in which pharmaceutical firms target detailing visits to physicians who learn about drug quality and prescribe accordingly. We derive several predictions about the role of information in these visits, which we then test empirically using prescriptions and pharmaceutical detailing visit data. We find limited empirical support of learning as the dominant mechanism, though cannot rule it out completely. We conclude with discussing alternative models that may be more consistent with the observed empirical patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证角度探讨信息在药品推广拜访（即医药代表与医生之间的促销互动）中的作用。我们首先构建了一个理论框架，其中制药企业针对医生进行定向推广拜访，医生通过此类拜访了解药品质量并据此开具处方。基于此框架，我们推导出关于信息在推广拜访中作用的若干预测，并利用处方数据与药品推广拜访数据进行了实证检验。研究发现，学习机制作为主导解释的实证支持有限，但无法完全排除其可能性。最后，我们讨论了与观察到的实证模式更为一致的替代模型。

title: Agricultural carbon emission efficiency and its regional convergence in China: Role of land use modes and economic factors
title_zh: 中国农业碳排放效率及其区域收敛性：土地利用模式与经济因素的作用
title_primary: 中国农业碳排放效率及其区域收敛性：土地利用模式与经济因素的作用
title_secondary: Agricultural carbon emission efficiency and its regional convergence in China: Role of land use modes and economic factors
authors: Yiqi Zhu, Hanwei Liang, Yifei Wang, Yuran Feng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: China’s agricultural sector is a key contributor to global carbon emissions, making improvements in Agricultural Carbon Emission Efficiency (ACEE) crucial for achieving climate and food security goals. Departing from traditional studies that often assume a singular nationwide evolutionary path, this research investigates the divergent convergence dynamics of ACEE through the lens of land-use modes to map its long-term evolution. By applying a club convergence methodology to provincial panel data from 2004 to 2020, we reject the hypothesis of a unique steady state and identify instead five distinct convergence clubs with heterogeneous equilibrium pathways, alongside a small group of non-converging provinces. The results reveal that agricultural land-use modes act as a fundamental sorting mechanism: while diversified systems generally facilitate higher efficiency equilibria, specialized production bases often face efficiency bottlenecks despite their scale advantages. Furthermore, the economic drivers of efficiency differ markedly across clusters, showing that imbalanced fixed-asset investment constrains further gains in high-efficiency regions, whereas narrowing urban-rural income gaps consistently supports efficiency across most clubs. These findings underscore the necessity of club-specific, locally adapted strategies that align production systems, land-use modes, and factor inputs with regional realities to foster sustainable agricultural development and enhance China's contribution to global carbon reduction.
abstract_zh: 中国农业部门是全球碳排放的重要贡献者，因此提升农业碳排放效率（ACEE）对于实现气候与粮食安全目标至关重要。不同于传统研究往往假设全国存在单一演化路径，本研究从土地利用模式的视角探讨ACEE的差异化收敛动态，以描绘其长期演变趋势。通过将俱乐部收敛方法应用于2004年至2020年的省级面板数据，我们拒绝了单一稳态的假设，识别出五个具有异质性均衡路径的收敛俱乐部，以及一小部分不收敛的省份。研究结果显示，农业土地利用模式作为基本的分类机制发挥作用：多元化系统通常促进更高效率的均衡状态，而专业化生产基地尽管具有规模优势，却常面临效率瓶颈。此外，各俱乐部间的经济驱动因素差异显著，表明固定资本投资失衡限制了高效率地区的进一步增益，而缩小城乡收入差距在大多数俱乐部中持续支持效率提升。这些发现强调了针对俱乐部特定、因地制宜策略的必要性，使生产系统、土地利用模式和要素投入与区域实际相匹配，以促进农业可持续发展，并增强中国对全球碳减排的贡献。

title: Identifying episodes of fiscal austerity: An LLM-based approach
title_zh: 识别财政紧缩时期：基于大语言模型的方法
title_primary: 识别财政紧缩时期：基于大语言模型的方法
title_secondary: Identifying episodes of fiscal austerity: An LLM-based approach
authors: Karan Bhasin, Prakash Loungani
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper introduces a hierarchical Large Language Model (LLM) framework for the automated identification of narrative fiscal shocks. We develop a multi-stage architecture to extract austerity episodes from IMF Article IV reports (2004–2020) for 17 OECD countries. Relative to manual coding, our approach improves replicability and auditability by generating a documented sequence of classification steps. Benchmarking against Adler et al. (2024), we find that the LLM-based classification aligns closely with the narrative benchmark, while differing on a small subset of episodes. Local projection estimates indicate that LLM-identified shocks are associated with smaller estimated multipliers than the narrative benchmark, with the difference linked in large part to differences in shock persistence and endogeneity.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种分层大型语言模型（LLM）框架，用于自动识别叙事性财政冲击。我们构建了一个多阶段架构，从17个OECD国家2004至2020年间的IMF第四条磋商报告中提取紧缩时期。相较于人工编码，我们的方法通过生成一系列有记录的分类步骤，提高了可复制性和可审计性。与Adler等人（2024）的基准相比，我们发现基于LLM的分类与叙事基准高度一致，但在少数事件上存在差异。局部投影估计表明，LLM识别的冲击所对应的乘数估计值小于叙事基准，这一差异在很大程度上与冲击的持续性和内生性差异有关。

title: Sustainable investing and market governance
title_zh: 可持续投资与市场治理
title_primary: 可持续投资与市场治理
title_secondary: Sustainable investing and market governance
authors: Alvin Chen, Deeksha Gupta, Jan Starmans
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how sustainable investing affects the governance role of financial markets. We show that stronger concerns about externalities among informed investors can reduce price informativeness about managerial effort to improve financial performance, increasing the cost of incentive provision. This mechanism creates an inherent link between firms’ environmental and social (ES) and governance quality. We show that the agency costs of sustainable investing can have real effects on ES outcomes when firms can change their externalities.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了可持续投资如何影响金融市场的治理作用。我们证明，知情投资者对外部性问题的更强关注可能会降低关于管理层提升财务绩效努力的股价信息含量，从而增加激励提供的成本。这一机制在企业环境与社会（ES）表现与治理质量之间建立了内在联系。我们进一步表明，当企业能够调整其外部性时，可持续投资的代理成本可能对ES结果产生实质性影响。

title: Beyond the last term: Analyzing politicians’ responsiveness in a no-term-limit context
title_zh: 超越最后任期：无任期限制背景下政治家回应性分析
title_primary: 超越最后任期：无任期限制背景下政治家回应性分析
title_secondary: Beyond the last term: Analyzing politicians’ responsiveness in a no-term-limit context
authors: Marco Frank, Nicola Maaser, David Stadelmann
official: 官方在线 2026-03-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the willingness of politicians in the German Bundestag to interact with voters, drawing on data capturing direct interchanges between citizens and their elected representatives to measure their responsiveness. In a setting without term limits, we examine whether electoral incentives influence politicians’ engagement with citizens. Our theoretical model predicts, and empirical results confirm, that politicians who are not seeking reelection become less responsive to voters, especially as election day approaches. This decline is attributed to a behavioral response resulting from a decrease in intra-party standing, rather than to a change in motivation or personal ideological convictions. Politicians retiring due to age or health reasons maintain consistent levels of interaction with voters, in contrast to those leaving due to pressure within their party or due to career changes, who exhibit decreased engagement with voters. Our findings offer novel insights into the role of incentives and constraints for political behavior in countries without mandatory term limits.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了德国联邦议院议员与选民互动的意愿，利用记录公民与其当选代表直接交流的数据来衡量其回应性。在无任期限制的背景下，我们考察选举激励是否影响政治家与公民的互动。我们的理论模型预测，且实证结果证实，不寻求连任的政治家对选民的回应性降低，尤其是在选举日临近时。这一下降归因于党内地位下降导致的行为反应，而非动机或个人意识形态信念的变化。因年龄或健康原因退休的政治家与选民的互动水平保持稳定，相比之下，因党内压力或职业变动而离任的政治家则表现出与选民互动减少。我们的发现为无强制任期限制国家中政治行为的激励与约束作用提供了新颖见解。

authors: Santosh Anagol, Vimal Balasubramaniam, Tarun Ramadorai, Antoine Uettwiller

abstract: A major goal of India’s 2016 demonetization was to curb tax evasion by reducing the use of cash in under-reported economic activity. We test whether the policy reduced under-reporting in real estate transactions — a market long suspected of widespread cash use and evasion. We find no change in aggregate under-reporting, but moderate declines among the 30% of transactions between individual buyers and sellers, relative to the 70% where developers are sellers. We also find evidence of under-reporting declines amongst smaller developers and regions where under-reporting was more common pre-demonetization. Our results, from a major Indian city, highlight both the limits of cash-based enforcement and the heterogeneous effects of demonetization style policies.
abstract_zh: 印度2016年废钞令的主要目标之一，是通过减少未报告经济活动中现金的使用来遏制逃税行为。我们检验了该政策是否减少了房地产交易中的低报现象——这一市场长期以来被怀疑存在广泛的现金使用和逃税行为。我们发现总体低报情况没有变化，但在个人买卖双方之间的30%交易中，相对于开发商作为卖方的70%交易，低报现象出现了适度下降。我们还发现，在较小的开发商以及废钞令前低报现象更为普遍的地区，低报情况有所减少。我们的研究结果来自印度一座主要城市，既凸显了基于现金执法手段的局限性，也揭示了废钞令式政策的异质性影响。

title: Long‐run housing price indices and determinants: New data from Huizhou, China, 1570–1949
title_zh: 长期房价指数及其决定因素：中国惠州的新数据（1570–1949）
title_primary: 长期房价指数及其决定因素：中国惠州的新数据（1570–1949）
title_secondary: Long‐run housing price indices and determinants: New data from Huizhou, China, 1570–1949
authors: Siyu Pan
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Economic studies on historical housing markets have gained increased popularity in recent years, yet remain limited by data scarcity. In this paper, a novel housing transaction dataset with more than 1000 observations from the historic Huizhou prefecture in south China is collected. This study develops housing price indices spanning the late Ming, Qing, and Republic of China eras (1570–1949). Results from hedonic ordinary and quantile regressions reveal unique housing price determinants tied to the region's cultural background: property orientation, proximity to ancestral halls and Buddhist temples, and seller's gender. Sellers being in urgent financial situations is positively correlated with the sales price.
abstract_zh: 关于历史住房市场的经济学研究近年来日益受到关注，但仍受限于数据稀缺。本文收集了来自中国南方历史徽州府超过1000条观测值的新型住房交易数据集。研究构建了跨越晚明、清代及民国时期（1570-1949年）的房价指数。通过特征价格普通回归与分位数回归的结果，揭示了与该地区文化背景紧密相关的独特房价决定因素：房产朝向、与祠堂及佛教寺庙的邻近程度，以及卖方性别。卖方处于紧急财务状况与销售价格呈正相关。

title: Unwilling to Reskill? Experimental Evidence from Real-World Jobseekers
title_zh: 不愿再培训？来自真实求职者的实验证据
title_primary: 不愿再培训？来自真实求职者的实验证据
title_secondary: Unwilling to Reskill? Experimental Evidence from Real-World Jobseekers
authors: Alexia Delfino, Andrea Garnero, Sergio Inferrera, Marco Leonardi, Raffaella Sadun 等
official: 官方在线 2026-01-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study barriers preventing jobseekers from pursuing reskilling in high-demand occupations. Using a discrete choice experiment, we quantify the demand for reskilling among Italian jobseekers in two white-collar high-demand occupations—information technology assistant and construction technician—and identify its main determinants. Willingness to pay estimates show that participants are willing to pay to reskill into IT, but would require compensation to reskill into construction. Beliefs about monetary returns and social status help explain differences in reskilling demand, but perceived identity fit in the target occupation emerges as the most important individual-level factor shaping reskilling decisions. A light-touch randomized information intervention providing data on occupational returns significantly increases both stated interest in reskilling and actual engagement in real- world training.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了阻碍求职者向高需求职业进行技能再培训的障碍。通过一项离散选择实验，我们量化了意大利求职者对两种白领高需求职业——信息技术助理和建筑技术员——的技能再培训需求，并识别了其主要决定因素。支付意愿估计显示，参与者愿意为转向信息技术领域支付费用，但转向建筑领域则需要补偿。对货币回报和社会地位的信念有助于解释技能再培训需求的差异，但目标职业中的感知身份契合度成为影响技能再培训决策的最重要的个体层面因素。一项提供职业回报数据的轻触式随机信息干预显著提高了对技能再培训的表态兴趣以及实际参与现实世界培训的积极性。

title: Does competition drive the sustainability and financial performance of firms? Evidence from G-20 nations
title_zh: 竞争是否驱动企业的可持续性与财务绩效？来自G20国家的证据
title_primary: 竞争是否驱动企业的可持续性与财务绩效？来自G20国家的证据
title_secondary: Does competition drive the sustainability and financial performance of firms? Evidence from G-20 nations
authors: Rajesh Bhue Ajaya Kumar Panda Mainak Mazumdar a Finance and Economics, Indian Institute of Management, Mumbai, Indiab Accounting and Finance, Indiac Economics and Strategy, India
official: 官方在线 2025-08-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To preserve a competitive edge and protect proprietary information, companies may strategically design their ESG disclosures in line with product market competition (PMC). This study aims to examine how the moderating role of PMC influences the relationship between sustainable practices and ‘firm financial performance’ (FFP). Using regression techniques on a sample of 2801 firms from G-20 countries over a study period covering from 2011 to 2023, findings show that firms’ sustainable practices positively impact FFP. PMC effectively acts as a disciplinary mechanism for firm’s performance and aligns with the deterrence hypothesis. Due to competitive pressure, sustainable practices increase firm performance. Although in all cases, PMC does not portray moderating effect to establish relationship between sustainable practices and firm value, the individual parameters, such as environmental and social practices, are enhancing FFP under high PMC levels. While in low competition, environmental practices detriment FFP due to competitive disadvantages. Further, in developed countries, PMC is ineffective, whereas it effectively works for developing countries. Using alternative competition measures, sensitivity analysis, and propensity score matching, the present study provides robust empirical evidence to validate the moderating role of PMC in shaping ESG-FFP dynamics. Managers may leverage PMC strategically; investors and policymakers ought to keep on surveillance for greenwashing.
abstract_zh: 为保持竞争优势并保护专有信息，企业可能根据产品市场竞争（PMC）策略性地设计其ESG披露。本研究旨在探讨PMC的调节作用如何影响可持续实践与企业财务绩效（FFP）之间的关系。基于2011至2023年间G20国家2801家企业的样本数据，采用回归分析发现：企业可持续实践对FFP具有正向影响。PMC有效发挥企业绩效的惩戒机制作用，与威慑假说一致。在竞争压力下，可持续实践提升了企业绩效。尽管在所有情形中PMC均未表现出调节可持续实践与企业价值关系的效应，但在高PMC水平下，环境与社会实践等单项指标均能提升FFP；而在低竞争环境下，环境实践因竞争劣势反而损害FFP。此外，PMC在发达国家中调节效应不显著，但在发展中国家表现有效。通过采用替代竞争指标、敏感性分析和倾向得分匹配，本研究为PMC在ESG-FFP动态关系中的调节作用提供了稳健的实证证据。管理者可策略性运用PMC；投资者与政策制定者需持续警惕漂绿行为。
